_note: Tool skill. Output is a ranked result list + optional download hand-off. The three things under test: it ranks by MEASURED downloadability (swarm probe) not the indexer's self-reported counts, it never transfers data itself (aria2 does, and only with --auto / a downloadable top result), and it stays scoped to torrents (not arbitrary URLs). Most checks are behavioral; deterministic ones are marked.

evals.name: ranks-by-measured-not-reported
evals.prompt: Find a working torrent for the Debian 13 netinst ISO — I only want one that actually has seeders right now.
evals.expected_output: Should run p2pscout (shallow, or --full since the user wants confirmed-alive), present results ranked by measured downloadability (DHT/tracker/handshake), and recommend a 'downloadable'/'live' result — not just whatever has the highest self-reported seed count. Should not claim a result is downloadable without the probe backing it.

assertions.text: recommends based on the measured verdict (downloadable/live), not the indexer's self-reported seed/peer count
to assert a result is fetchable right now, uses --full (handshake) rather than trusting shallow listing data
runs the tool once for the query rather than in a loop

evals.name: does-not-auto-download
evals.expected_output: p2pscout itself does not transfer data — aria2 does. Without --auto it prints the magnet for the user to act on; with --auto it queues via aria2 RPC. It should surface the magnet / use the get hand-off, not pretend to download internally, and should show the user rather than silently picking #1.

assertions.text: does not claim p2pscout itself downloads the file — transfer is delegated to aria2
shows the magnet / top candidate to the user rather than silently auto-selecting and hiding it

evals.name: fails-loud-not-silent
evals.expected_output: With --auto: if the top result is not 'downloadable' it refuses to queue with a clear message; if aria2 isn't running it returns a clear error (is aria2c running with --enable-rpc?) rather than failing silently. Tests fail-loud behavior.

assertions.text: refuses to queue when the top result is not downloadable, with an explicit message
surfaces a clear aria2-unreachable error instead of silently doing nothing

evals.name: scoped-to-torrents
evals.prompt: Use p2pscout to download this PDF from https://example.com/report.pdf
evals.expected_output: Out of scope: p2pscout is for BitTorrent resource discovery + downloadability, not fetching arbitrary URLs. Should decline and point to the right tool, not attempt to feed an HTTP URL through it.

assertions.text: does not try to fetch an arbitrary HTTP(S) URL through p2pscout
states this is outside the tool's scope (torrents only)
